subject: *: fix `insert on duplicate` and `replace into` with global index (#53717)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. The change unifies unique-index handle decoding via `tablecodec.DecodeHandleInIndexValue`, adds `kv.PartitionHandle`-aware record-key encoding (`tablecodec.EncodeRecordKey`), and threads that through insert/replace duplicate handling plus point-get/batch-point-get and admin index cleanup/recover paths for global index. No remaining Blocker/High issues after checking later history up to `upstream/master` (a potential temp-index deleted-handle mismatch for global index is addressed later and thus not a remaining issue).
